label: IEEE Conference Publication · ISITIA 2023
title: Word Syllabification for Indonesian Language using Transformer
description: Developed a character-level syllable-tagging approach with a Transformer architecture for Indonesian syllabification. The work used KBBI and named-entity corpora and reported a 3.68% Word Error Rate, improving on the 3.75% result cited as the previous best deep-learning model in the project evaluation.
authors: Muhammad Haykal Kamil · Suyanto · Mochammad Arif Bijaksana
venue: 2023 International Seminar on Intelligent Technology and Its Applications
